message.content:
### Overall Layout & Structure  
The page has a **dark-themed, centered layout** with a prominent calculator module (for event cost estimation) as the focal point. The background is solid black (#121212 or similar), creating high contrast with lighter text/elements. The design is minimalistic, with clear hierarchy and ample whitespace to avoid clutter.  


### Header & Navigation  
- **Logo**: Top-left features the brand name “UNILOV” in a serif font (gold/cream color, ~24px), with “CATERIN” in smaller, lighter text below it.  
- **Navigation Menu**: Horizontal menu at the top, with 8 items (e.g., “ФОРМАТЫ”, “ФУРШЕТ”, “БАНКЕТ”) in a clean, sans-serif font (white/light gray, ~14px). Items are evenly spaced, with no underlines or active states visible.  
- **Contact Info**: Top-right displays a phone number (“+7 (812) 919-59-11”) in the same font/color as the menu, aligned right.  


### Main Calculator Module  
A rounded, dark gray (#1E1E1E) container occupies the center of the page, with the following sections:  

#### 1. Headline & Subheadline  
- **Headline**: “Рассчитайте стоимость” (Calculate the cost) — “Рассчитайте” is white (serif font, ~36px), “стоимость” is gold (serif font, ~36px), creating visual hierarchy.  
- **Subheadline**: “Приблизительный расчёт — точную стоимость уточнит менеджер” (Approximate calculation — the manager will clarify the exact cost) — smaller, light gray sans-serif text (~14px), centered below the headline.  

#### 2. Form Fields  
- **“ФОРМАТ” (Format) Section**:  
  - Label: “ФОРМАТ” (dark gray, ~14px, uppercase).  
  - Dropdown: “Фуршет (от 1 800 Р/чел)” (white text, ~16px) with a subtle down arrow. The dropdown has a dark gray background and thin border.  
- **“КОЛИЧЕСТВО ГОСТЕЙ” (Number of Guests) Section**:  
  - Label: “КОЛИЧЕСТВО ГОСТЕЙ” (dark gray, ~14px, uppercase).  
  - Slider: A horizontal slider with a gold handle (circular) and track. The current value (“50 чел.”) is displayed in gold text to the right of the slider.  
- **“ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЕ УСЛУГИ” (Additional Services) Section**:  
  - Label: “ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЕ УСЛУГИ” (dark gray, ~14px, uppercase).  
  - Dropdown: “Без доп. услуг” (white text, ~16px) with a down arrow, similar styling to the “ФОРМАТ” dropdown.  

#### 3. Cost Display  
- **Subheadline**: “Приблизительная стоимость” (Approximate cost) — light gray, centered, ~14px.  
- **Total Cost**: “90 000 ₽” — large, gold serif font (~48px), centered.  
- **Disclaimer**: “Точная стоимость после консультации с менеджером” (Exact cost after consultation with the manager) — small, light gray sans-serif text (~12px), centered below the total.  

#### 4. CTA Button  
- **Button**: “ПОЛУЧИТЬ ТОЧНЫЙ РАСЧЁТ” (Get an exact calculation) — gold background, dark gray text (~16px, sans-serif), rounded corners, centered below the cost display. Hover state is not visible but likely includes a subtle shadow or color shift.  


### Visual Elements & Spacing  
- **Whitespace**: Generous padding around the calculator module (e.g., 40px top/bottom, 60px left/right) and between form sections (e.g., 20px between “ФОРМАТ” and “ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЕ УСЛУГИ”) ensures readability.  
- **Colors**: Dominant black background; gold/cream for accents (headlines, button, slider handle, total cost); white/light gray for text; dark gray for form containers/labels.  
- **Typography**: Mix of serif (headlines, total cost) and sans-serif (subheadlines, menu, form text) fonts. Serif adds elegance; sans-serif ensures clarity.  
- **Images/Icons**: No images, but a green WhatsApp icon (circle, bottom-right) is visible — likely a floating action button for contact.  


### Visual Issues (Minor)  
- **Dropdown Clarity**: The down arrows in the dropdowns are subtle (light gray) and may be hard to distinguish on the dark background.  
- **Slider Handle Contrast**: The gold slider handle contrasts well with the dark track, but the track itself is very dark (almost black), which could reduce visibility for users with low vision.  
- **Button Hover State**: Not visible in the screenshot, but a hover effect (e.g., darker gold or shadow) would improve interactivity.  


### Summary  
The design is sleek and functional, with a strong focus on the calculator. The dark theme, gold accents, and clear typography create a premium feel, while the layout prioritizes ease of use. Minor tweaks (e.g., enhancing dropdown arrows, slider track visibility) could improve accessibility.
